module: GE extension (core_audioRibbon): dynamic audio for 'ribbons' (rivers, waterfalls, etc.) defined in the editor. A ribbon is a strip of quadrilaterals (nodes in left/right pairs, with depth). Every frame, for the listener (SFXSystem), the module tracks the closest point on each nearby ribbon and drives up to 5 SFX emitters per event (1 central/ambient 'A', then 4 around the listener: F front, B back, R right, L left), setting volume, pitch, color and texture (RTPC) from the ribbon's width, depth and speed. Ribbons are loaded from levels/<level>/dynamicAudioEmitters/ribbonData.audioSFX.json (JSON lines format, one ribbon per line), written by the editor on save. Many exported functions are mainly for the editor.
usage:
local rib = core_audioRibbon.getRibbons()
for i, r in ipairs(rib or {}) do print(r.name, r.numSegs) end
notes: Ribbon structure: {persistantId, name, isEnabled, isAmbient, isUpRibbon, isTopActive, isQuadAndVolume, isMuteA..D, speed, nodes (vec3 in pairs), depths (per node), widths (per pair, computed), numSegs (computed), emitters[1..5]}.
A ribbon's emitters (emitters) are 'hosts': {bestSeg, dir, vol, pos, bN, eventNameStr}. emitters[1] = event A (center/ambient), 2 = F (front), 3 = B (back), 4 = R (right), 5 = L (left).

Distance management: 'near' list (at most the 2 closest ribbons, all emitters active), 'mid' (internal point only) and 'far' (one ribbon per frame in round robin). Near/far limit: 400 m (nearFarLimitSq = 400²).
Closest-point tracking uses a directional walk (1 segment per frame) and a random probe (blue noise) every 3 frames to escape local minima.
Provisional weighting coefficients in the code (comment 'TODO - REMOVE LATER WHEN SYSTEM IS TUNED'): width 100, depth 100, speed 100, exponential offset 800.

Inconsistency: readRibbonsFromFile does not re-read isMuteA..D (the file does not contain them): after a level loads they are nil (so not muted); only onSerialize/onDeserialized keeps them across a Lua reload.
Side effect: onSerialize deletes all ribbons and emitters after copying them (removeRibbon for each ribbon).
Inconsistency: createSfxEmitter uses ffi.string(eventName) although eventName is a Lua string (accepted by LuaJIT); the event name is therefore converted needlessly.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: reads the listener pose, updates the near/mid/far lists, computes the closest points and RTPCs for each nearby ribbon, then creates/drives the SFXEmitter emitters (positions and setVolumePitchCT). Does nothing if there are no ribbons.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook before Lua reload: returns a full copy of the ribbons then DELETES all ribbons and emitters. Returns nil if there are no ribbons.

onDeserialized.desc: Restore hook after Lua reload: rebuilds the ribbons (nodes as vec3, emitter hosts, widths, numSegs) and the names table.

onEditorBeforeSaveLevel.desc: Hook called before the level is saved in the editor: writes the ribbons to levels/<level>/dynamicAudioEmitters/ribbonData.audioSFX.json (sorted by name).

onClientCustomObjectSpawning.desc: Hook called when the level objects are created: resets the ribbons then re-reads the level's ribbonData.audioSFX.json file.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the level: removes the emitters and empties the ribbons (resetRibbons).

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game closes: removes all dynamic SFX emitters.

createEmitterHost.desc: Creates the record of a dynamic emitter host (initial position at infinity, bestSeg 0, direction 1).

updateRibbonData.desc: To call after any change to a ribbon's nodes: resets bestSeg=1 and dir=1 for the 5 hosts, recomputes ribbon.numSegs = max(0, (#nodes - 4)/2 + 1) and ribbon.widths (distance between the two nodes of each pair).

removeRibbon.desc: Removes all SFX emitters, removes the ribbon at index idx from the list and from the names table, and empties the near/mid/far lists.

recomputeMap.desc: Rebuilds the names table (persistantId -> true) from the ribbons.

clearAllSFXEmitters.desc: Removes all dynamic SFXEmitter objects (5 axes) and empties their table.

clearNearFarLists.desc: Empties the near, mid and far lists (they will be rebuilt next frame).

getRibbons.desc: Returns the list of ribbons (nil before the first load).

setRibbons.desc: Replaces the list of ribbons (used by the editor).

getRibbonNames.desc: Returns the table of known ribbon identifiers (persistantId -> true).

getNearList.desc: Returns the near list (persistantId -> ribbon index), at most 2 ribbons.

getMidList.desc: Returns the mid list (ribbons within 400 m, only the internal point updated).

getFarList.desc: Returns the far list (distant ribbons, only one visited per frame).

getSfxEmitters.desc: Returns the 5 per-axis SFX emitter tables, keyed by event name ({emitter, vol, pitch, color, texture, pos}).
